# CANDIDATE: OPENING_GAP_RETEST_VWAP_SUPPORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A gap that leaves price away from VWAP often returns to VWAP as dynamic support/resistance, providing a mean-reversion entry. Entry rule: If opening gap > 0.2% (price at open vs prior close) AND price > VWAP (gap up) or < VWAP (gap down) after the first 15 minutes, enter opposite direction when price crosses VWAP with a candle closing on the other side.

## Mechanism
- Calculate opening gap: (open - prior close) / prior close. If |gap| > 0.002, proceed.
- After first 15 minutes (09:45 ET), check if price is above VWAP (gap up) or below VWAP (gap down).
- Wait for price to cross VWAP and close on the opposite side (e.g., for gap up, wait for close below VWAP; for gap down, wait for close above VWAP).
- Enter trade opposite gap direction (short for gap up, long for gap down).
- Exit: Chart-stop at prior day's high (for longs) or low (for shorts), TP1 at 1R, runner trail using premium-stop % (e.g., 20% of entry premium).
- Regime filters: Only trade when VIX < 25 and time between 09:45-11:30 ET; avoid when VIX > 30 or gap > 1% (risk of continuation).
